title: Reports
description: Regulatory returns and operational reports to read on screen, print or download as CSV.

ctls-monthly.title: CTLS monthly report
ctls-monthly.description: The unpackaged inventory for Health Canada’s monthly cannabis tracking report, laid out like the official form: seeds, vegetative and whole plants, fresh and dried cannabis, with every addition and reduction line.

destruction-register.title: Destruction register
destruction-register.description: Every destruction with the unit, experiment, cultivar, date and reason, ready for an inspector.

inventory-snapshot.title: Inventory snapshot
inventory-snapshot.description: Every active unit right now, grouped by type, growth stage, location and cultivar, with weights and seed counts.

state-at-date.title: Inventory state at a date
state-at-date.description: What the laboratory held at the end of a chosen day, rebuilt from each event’s effective date.

inventory-movement.title: Inventory movement ledger
inventory-movement.description: Additions (registrations, derivations, receipts) and reductions (destructions, shipments) over a period, with every other change.

transfer-log.title: Chain of custody: location transfers
transfer-log.description: Every move between locations with the operator, the time and whether the barcode was scanned.

experiment-summary.title: Experiment summary
experiment-summary.description: For each experiment: active, destroyed and shipped units, by type, with the team and the timeline.

stage-history.title: Stage transition history
stage-history.description: Every change of growth stage across all units, with who recorded it and any comment.

activity-audit.title: Audit trail export
activity-audit.description: The audit trail for a period with field-level changes, for sharing outside the application.

locked.title: Reports are for administrators
locked.body: Reports show inventory quantities and the audit trail, so they stay with administrators. The dashboard and the compliance console show the live position to every member.

filters.zoneNote: Dates are calendar days in the laboratory time zone ({zone}).

ctls.heading: Unpackaged inventory
ctls.flow: Laid out like Health Canada’s reporting form. On every class, closing = opening + additions − reductions. Seeds and plants are counted; fresh and dried cannabis are in kilograms.
ctls.caption: Unpackaged inventory by class and line
ctls.notOnForm: Not on the form for this class

lines.shippedTesters: Shipped in Canada – to analytical testers
lines.shippedCultivators: Shipped in Canada – to cultivators and processors

ctls.reconciled: Reconciled: on every class, closing = opening + additions − reductions.
ctls.notReconciled: Not reconciled: on at least one class, closing differs from opening + additions − reductions. Investigate before filing.

checks.licenceIdMissing: No licence number. Enter it above, or set LAB_LICENSE_ID for the laboratory.
checks.recipientUnclassified: Reported under “Other reductions” because the recipient has no licence class: {names}. Set the licence class on the organization.
checks.countryMissing: Counted as Canadian because no country is recorded: {names}.
checks.unweighed: Harvested with no weight, so in no class: {names}. Weigh them to report them as fresh or dried cannabis.
checks.trimShipped: {count, plural, one {# trim line} other {# trim lines}} shipped ({grams} g) {count, plural, one {is not an inventory unit and is} other {are not inventory units and are}} not on the form. Add the weight by hand if it applies.

cultures.heading: Tissue cultures
cultures.body: Health Canada’s form has no class for tissue cultures, so they are not in the table. Opening {opening}, added {added}, removed {removed}, closing {closing}.

ctls.filing: “Download CTLS form” gives columns A to JS of Health Canada’s reporting form: the reporting period and the unpackaged inventory, with zeros for the classes the laboratory does not hold. Paste its second row into the official form, then complete packaged inventory, sales and business statistics in CTLS. Value ($) columns are left blank: Accession Book keeps no book value.

notes.zone: Months are calendar months in the laboratory time zone ({zone}). Dates are the effective date of each event, not the date it was filed.
notes.classes: Seed lots are seeds. Plants that are not flowering are vegetative plants; flowering plants are whole plants. Harvested material is fresh cannabis at its wet weight until a dry weight is recorded, then dried cannabis at its dry weight.
notes.transformations: A plant that starts flowering is processed out of vegetative plants and produced into whole plants. A harvested plant is processed out of plants and produced into fresh cannabis. Drying processes fresh cannabis into dried cannabis; the moisture lost is the drying loss.
notes.counterparties: Receipts from, and shipments to, organizations outside Canada are imported or exported. Shipments within Canada go on the line for the recipient’s licence class.
notes.remeasure: A lower weight on re-weighing is a drying or processing loss and a higher one is an other addition. A seed recount is an other addition or reduction.
notes.notRecorded: Accession Book does not record packaged inventory, returns, losses and thefts, or book values: those lines are zero. Enter them in CTLS if they apply.

sectionDescriptions.additions-detail: Each unit that entered inventory during the period. Open a unit to see its live profile.
sectionDescriptions.destruction-records: The destruction date is when the material was destroyed; filed at is when the record was entered.
sectionDescriptions.form-movements: Every quantity on the form, event by event: the class and line it went on. Open a unit to see its history.
